author: Athul Prem

measured_linux_map_execution.scope: GNU time measurement for the native Linux map invocation, including assembly and solve.

scope: The matched blocks have five left-incident drives and 25 propagating coefficients per direction. Power uses native incident-power fractions. Phase differences are wrapped at the original planes after signed SAFE gauge alignment. The 225 to 168.75 nm pair also changed solve platform. The 168.75 to 126.5625 nm pair changes preparation platform and central mesh. These finite increments at 1 GHz leave continuum and frequency convergence unresolved.
